rationale: Pickup set to the minimum allowed by load-avoidance: 420 A * 1.2 = 504 A (primary), yielding sensitivity factor 1800/504 = 3.571 (>= 1.5) and secondary pickup 504/100 = 5.04 A within [1.0, 10.0] A. Time delay set to the minimum selective value: 0.35 + 0.3 = 0.65 s, within [0.0, 2.0] s. Minimizing pickup maximizes the minimum-fault sensitivity factor.
